rows.en:
(Well, I left the house, but now
I can't decide what to do...)

Oh, \p, what's up?
You look like you've got time to kill.
You're sharp, Sensei...

You're young, and look at you. Hopeless.
Summer's all about the sea and women!
Just get yourself to the pool or the beach!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Gary says 'the sea and women' to the female player too; she objects in c16195.

rows.en: That's pretty extreme, Sensei...

You idiot!
That's what summer's always been about! Go ask Itsuki!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Itsuki = Yamashiro-sensei (Gary uses his given name).

rows.en: ...I seriously doubt he'd say the same thing...
rows.notes: Male scene. Muttered aside; Gary half-hears it.

rows.en: Huh? You say something?
Nothing at all! Thank you very much!

(I bet Sensei spent his summers
chasing the sea and women...)

(Well, I left the house, but now
I'm not sure what I should do...)
Sensei, you're kind of sharp...

Sensei, I'm a girl, you know...
And that's kind of extreme...
...I really doubt he'd give the same answer...
Nothing! Thank you very much!

(Sensei must have spent his summers with
the sea and women. I just know it.)

(Just a few more days till Sheryl's concert.
Can't wait~)

Oh, \p, what's up?
What's with that big grin on your face?

Nothing, I was just thinking
Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...

!?
...Don't tell me... you're going...?
Yes, though only as part of the stunt crew...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. The player flies stunts at the concert.

rows.en:
*ahem* Ah, right, I heard something about that...
You know, I wouldn't mind going in your place...

No, well, I mean, I've got better flying skills.
When it comes to stunts, compared to you...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Trails off; the player answers with silence.

rows.en:
...Yeah, figured as much...
Alright, off you go! Show 'em the Mihoshi spirit!
(Gary-sensei... So he wanted to go...)

Yeah, I was just thinking
Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
(Gary-sensei... So he really wanted to go...)
(So they've finally found a new planet...)
rows.notes: Male scene. hoshi read as the new planet the fleet has found.

rows.en:
Oh, what's up, \p?
You've got a pretty serious look on your face.

Gary-sensei...
What do you think about the new planet?

What do I think...? Nothing much...
It's like a new woman. Whether you stick
together or drift apart, it's all fate.
Huh... It's that simple...?

Don't overthink it.
Everything works out the way it's meant to.

Oh, okay...
I'm kind of starting to feel that way too.

That's the spirit. Don't go thinking
about stuff you don't need to.

(Gary-sensei says something good
once in a while.)
(They've finally found a new planet, huh...)

(Maybe Gary-sensei does say something good
once in a while.)

(Whoa~ It's already this late...
I'd better hurry home...)

Hey~! \p! *hic*...
Found you~!! *hic*...

Huh, Gary-sensei?
(Ugh, he reeks of booze...)

Shameful... *hic*...
Out at... *hic*... this hour... *hic*...
wandering around...
(Ugh, I can barely tell what he's saying anymore...)
As punishment, you're taking me home~!! *hic*...

Huh? Come on, I don't even know
where you live in the first place...
\p, sorry for the trouble.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Yamashiro apologises on Gary's behalf.

rows.en: Yamashiro-sensei?

I'll take this guy home.
You hurry home too.
(Maybe Gary-sensei can't hold his liquor...)

(Whoa~ It's already this late...
I've gotta hurry home...)

Huh, Gary-sensei?
(Eww, he totally smells of booze~...)
(Hmm, I can't even tell what he's saying anymore...)

Huh, seriously? I don't even know
where you live in the first place...
Okay, I'll leave him to you.
rows.notes: Female scene. yoroshiku onegaishimasu: handing Gary over to Yamashiro.

rows.en: (I can't believe the city... ended up like this...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. After an attack on the city.

rows.en: Shit!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. kusoga: kept at full strength.

rows.en:
I was... I was right here,
and it happened again...
No more... I won't let them do any more...

Listen. You'd better take this to heart too.
This is a fight where it's live or die...

(Being a military pilot too,
this must be hard on him...)

(Being a military pilot too,
this must be really hard on him...)

uncertain: c16210/c16219/c16212: atarashii hoshi read as 'the new planet' the fleet has found (not a star).
c16238: kusoga rendered 'Shit!' (full strength, Gary's rough speech).
